access.complete: GitHub’s visible collaborator list was retrieved. Review the accounts below.
access.configuration: The data repository configuration is missing or invalid. Run the installation check below.
access.heading: Who can access your data?
access.help: Check which GitHub accounts have access to the data repository, including its Git history. This is separate from permission to sign in to MyShotLog.
access.internal: Internal repository — enterprise members can also read the data without appearing individually in this list.
access.limit: The check reached its limit of 1,000 collaborator entries. Review the complete list on GitHub.
access.limits: This is a snapshot of accounts visible to the token, not a complete security guarantee. It does not list GitHub Apps, deploy keys, pending invitations or existing copies and backups. Anyone with repository read access can read all journals stored there.
access.manage: Review and manage access on GitHub
access.organization: Organization access can come through teams or default permissions. GitHub reports effective roles without identifying the source of each grant.
access.partial: Only part of the account list could be retrieved. Additional accounts may have access.
access.permissions: GitHub did not allow this token to list collaborators. Review access on GitHub. The token owner needs write, maintain or admin access; organization repositories also require organization membership.
access.private: Private repository — access is restricted by GitHub permissions.
access.providerRateLimited: GitHub temporarily limited requests. Try again later.
access.public: Public repository — anyone can read your personal data, even without appearing in this list. Make the data repository private on GitHub.
access.unavailable: The account list could not be verified. This does not mean nobody else has access.
access.unsupported: Automatic access checks are available for the GitHub storage adapter. Review access with your Git hosting provider.
api.invalidData: Inputs or repository data are invalid. Check the fields and export format.
api.photoLimit: Save at most 10 new photos at a time. Save the session, then add more.
api.storageFailure: The Git journal could not be read or saved. Check the server connection.
api.tooLarge: The file is too large (max 3 MB).
auth.configure: Configure GitHub sign-in using the setup guide.
auth.denied: Your GitHub account does not have access to this journal installation. Contact the instance owner.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait and try again.

error.loadHelp: Check your connection and the server's Git repository and branch configuration.
event.classHelp: Suggested from the firearm’s details. Check the division against the rules. Save a default class per sport on the firearm for quicker entry.
event.help: A session has one firearm and one sport. The program fills series and known conditions. Choose Manual layout to edit program conditions.
event.opticReview: The optic may affect the division. Enter a class that matches the selected program.
event.ppc22: PPC does not permit rimfire .22 ammunition. Select a suitable firearm or record this as custom practice.
event.replace: This program replaces the current series and their results. Continue?
event.variableHelp: Distances, shot counts and targets vary. Enter each stage’s actual conditions from the match briefing.
firearm.classDefaultHelp: Enter only classes you have checked against the rules. PPC divisions differ from A/B/C weapon groups. Firearm changes do not alter past sessions.
firearm.emptyHelp: Add your first firearm. You can also record sessions with borrowed firearms.
firearm.help: You enter the classification and should check it against the rules for each discipline. Serial numbers appear only here and in your personal JSON export. The firearm's default discipline is selected automatically for a new session. You can then change it.
firearm.listHelp: Private information. History is kept when a firearm is archived.
import.attachedQuick: A quick series is already attached to a session
import.photoMissing: Photo reference is missing from the import
installation.accessFailed: GitHub access could not be confirmed. Check the repository name, token expiry, Contents permission and any organization approval.
installation.branchMissing: The configured branch is missing from a repository that already has other branches. Check GIT_DATABASE_BRANCH.
installation.callbackManual: In the GitHub OAuth app, confirm that Authorization callback URL is your site address followed by /auth/github/callback/. The repository token cannot read this registration.
installation.completed: Check complete. Review the items requiring manual confirmation.
installation.configured: The setting is present and its format is valid.
installation.deploymentManual: In Vercel, confirm that variables apply to Production and Git integration deploys the correct branch. Redeploy after environment changes. A GitHub token cannot verify these project settings.
installation.emptyRepo: The repository is empty. Import data in Settings or create your first entry; the app can then initialize the branch.
installation.errors: Problems found. Correct the marked settings and redeploy after changing environment variables.
installation.failed: The check could not complete. Try again later.
installation.heading: Installation check
installation.help: Check configuration and access without writing to the repository. Secret values are never displayed. Some settings need manual confirmation.
installation.invalid: The setting is invalid or inconsistent. Check the setup guide.
installation.journalUnavailable: The journal could not be read. Use the installation check below to investigate the configuration.
installation.missing: A value is missing or still a placeholder. Set a real value and redeploy.
installation.originMismatch: The address you are using differs from NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL. Check the production domain and OAuth callback; preview deployments may use a different address.
installation.originOk: The current address matches the configured site.
installation.privateOk: GitHub confirms that the journal repository is private.
installation.publicRepo: The journal repository is public. Make it private before saving personal data.
installation.readOk: The token can read the configured branch’s Git reference.
installation.readOnly: The repository is archived or disabled and cannot be updated.
installation.remoteManual: The Git adapter requires Git on the server and access to its remote repository. Use the GitHub adapter on Vercel. Git remote access is not automatically checked here.
installation.updateOk: The code fork, branch and deployed commit can be checked. Updates are applied manually on GitHub.
installation.writeManual: Read access does not prove write access. Confirm Contents: Read and write for the journal token and branch rules that allow app commits. No test commit is created.
issues.attachHelp: Add any other details and alternatives. You can attach reviewed screenshots on GitHub.
issues.copyFailed: Copying is unavailable. Select the report text and copy it manually.
issues.detailHelp: Give as much useful detail as you can. For problems: what did you do and what happened? For suggestions: what would you like to do, and why?
issues.draftReady: Your draft is ready. If GitHub did not open, use the link below. The report is submitted only when you choose to create the issue on GitHub.
issues.environmentHelp: Add your browser version, operating system and whether you use a phone or computer. You can edit or remove the prefilled details.
issues.fullReportReference: See the full report in Additional details below.
issues.heading: Report a problem or suggest an improvement
issues.intro: Tell us what is wrong or how MyShotLog could improve. Choose a type below. You review and submit the issue on GitHub.
issues.longReport: The report is too long for a web link. Copy the full report or select the text below. Open the draft and paste it into Additional details on GitHub. All details are preserved.
issues.privacy: GitHub issues are public. Remove passwords, tokens, private repository details and personal journal data. Check screenshots before attaching them.
issues.required: Enter a title and text in the required description fields.
issues.security: Report security vulnerabilities privately to security@aaw.se
issues.title: Short descriptive title

profile.ageHelp: Your date of birth is used for the age adjustment for bronze, silver and gold series. Precision thresholds decrease by 1 point from age 55 and 2 points from age 65, using age at the end of the previous calendar year. Application requirements are unchanged. Rules are selected by the session date. Previously recorded birth information is used when available; older series without it use the profile. Without birth information, standard thresholds apply.
profile.birthYearHelp: . It is used until you enter a date of birth.
profile.closeHelp: To also close your account, contact the installation owner. They remove your GitHub ID from the server allowlist. Complete erasure also requires handling Git history, clones and backups.
profile.deleteHelp: This removes your sessions, firearms, profile and assessments from the current journal. Previous versions remain in Git history. Export first if you want a copy.
profile.exportFailed: The export could not be downloaded.
profile.exportHelp: JSON includes your profile, firearms, raw results, recorded birth information, quick series and photos. Assessments are excluded. CSV contains results for spreadsheets.
profile.heading: Your profile
profile.importHelp: Existing IDs are skipped. Import is atomic and affects only your account. Your existing profile is kept. Series are evaluated using the rules valid on the session date.
profile.invalidJson: The file is not valid JSON.
qualifications.help: Personal progress based on your saved results and the series rule version.
qualifications.intro: Achievements and remaining tests, with traceable rules.
qualifications.path: Standard pistol shooting badge test route
qualifications.sourceHelp: The edition is published by SPSF and obtained through Svenska PPC-cupen. Later amendments have not been fully reviewed. Current metadata and limitations are documented in docs/RULES.md. Assessments are shown for each session. Rules are selected by the session date; previously recorded birth information is used when available, otherwise the profile is used.
quick.compatibleHelp: Select series with the same date, sport and course of fire.
quick.createSession: Create a session with these series →
quick.heading: Quick series entry
quick.inboxHelp: Select series from the same date and discipline to combine them into a session.
quick.intro: Save now. Combine your series into a session later.
quick.noSession: No session with the same date and discipline
quick.retry: Your entries are kept. Try again.
quick.saved: Series saved. Ready for the next one!
quick.sessionHelp: Choose the firearm, location, distance, target type and shooting time when linking the series to a session. Its medal level is shown afterwards.
resources.changed: SPSF has changed its documents. Review the new rules and update the app when support is available. Past results stay unchanged.
resources.checkHelp: This checks the handbook link and file against SPSF’s publication. Also read the federation’s amendments, interpretations and competition rules. Checks may be up to six hours old. No journal data is sent and past results are not reassessed.
resources.checkTitle: Are the app’s SPSF rules current?
resources.current: The published handbook matches the version reviewed for this app.
resources.handgun: SDSSF: IPSC handgun 2026 in Swedish, PDF
resources.intro: Get rulebooks from the federations, along with amendments and updates. Downloading does not change the app’s grades.
resources.ipsc: IPSC: current rulebooks for all disciplines
resources.title: Download rules
resources.unknown: The latest rules could not be confirmed. Check the SPSF website.
rules.applicationInput: Application assessment requires six shots, a hit count and shooting time.
rules.beforeBirth: The test date is before the date or year of birth.
rules.noVersion: No verified rule version covers the result date.
rules.outsideVersion: The test date is outside the series' recorded rule version.
rules.precisionInput: Precision assessment requires five shots and a whole-number score from 0 to 50.
rules.precisionScoreNoBirth: {points} out of at least {threshold} points. No age adjustment; birth information is missing.
rules.progressHelp: Three recorded precision achievements plus three application achievements within the calendar year. Each series uses its recorded rules and birth information. Alternative test routes, previous badges and club decisions are assessed separately. Not an official certificate.
rules.unsupportedGroup: This weapon group is not covered by the implemented test route.
rules.unsupportedSport: Badge and medal rules for this discipline are not implemented yet.
session.deleteHelp: Remove this session and its assessments from the current journal? Git history is kept.
session.legacyHelp: This older session has different distances, targets or times per series. They are kept until you select a shared value above.
session.linkQuickHelp: quick series will be linked when you save the session. Their date and discipline are kept.
session.newHelp: Save your results while the experience is fresh.
session.resultsHelp: Record series or stages. For dynamic shooting, enter points before penalties, penalties and measured time. HF is shown for IPSC; enter official place and percentage manually.
session.revisionHelp: A new revision and assessments are saved. Previous assessments are kept.
session.ruleReferenceHelp: Check against the event’s rules. This is saved with the session and does not enable automatic medal grading.
session.sharedHelp: Distance, target and time limit apply to the whole session. Measured time is the result’s actual time. Use the group/class field for your division and program for the event name.
sessions.emptyHelp: Record your first session and follow your progress over time.
sessions.intro: Results and lessons from every visit to the range.
settings.intro: Manage your profile and take your journal with you.

setup.heading: Your own shooting journal.
setup.history: Git history keeps previous versions even after deletion from the journal.
setup.intro: A private Git journal with one commit per saved entry.
setup.oauth: Register a GitHub OAuth app with callback /auth/github/callback/.
setup.repository: Choose a private Git repository and data branch.
setup.token: Configure the repository and server access token in .env.local.
setup.variables: Set the client ID, client secret, allowed GitHub IDs and session secret. Restart the app.

sync.authentication: Sign in again to synchronize. Pending changes remain stored for your account.
sync.browserHelp: This browser retains your journal and viewed photos, including after sign-out. Accounts and repositories are stored separately. You can restore a pending-changes backup only while signed in to the same journal. Reloading or signing in requires a connection; the open app supports offline reads and queued saves.
sync.conflict: A change needs your review before synchronization
sync.conflictHelp: Another device changed the same record. Both versions are retained until you choose which to keep. Keeping the device version replaces the current server record.
sync.failed: Synchronization could not finish. Your pending changes remain on this device.
sync.heading: Save and sync status
sync.invalid: The server could not accept the batch. Download your pending changes before troubleshooting or clearing browser storage.
sync.invalidPhoto: The optimized photo could not be stored. Select the image again.
sync.keepServer: Keep server version — discard {count} pending changes
sync.leavePending: Some changes are only saved on this device. Sign out and leave them here for your next sign-in? Cancel to synchronize or download a backup first.
sync.missingDependency: A referenced firearm, session or quick series is missing. Review the pending change.
sync.mustSync: Synchronize pending changes before continuing. Go to the sync status at the bottom right.
sync.notReady: Your journal has not loaded yet. Wait for synchronization before saving.
sync.offline: Offline — your saved changes stay on this device
sync.onlineOnly: This action requires a connection and completed synchronization.
sync.pending: {count} changes saved on this device — waiting to sync
sync.pendingHelp: Keep this browser’s data until synchronization finishes. Closing the app does not guarantee a final sync.
sync.queueFull: The queue is full or this save is too large. Synchronize existing changes and try again.
sync.rateLimited: Synchronization was temporarily limited. Pending changes will be retried later.
sync.resolveFailed: The change could not be resolved or restored. Download a backup of pending changes and review their dependencies.
sync.storageError: Browser storage is unavailable, full or unreadable. Local saves cannot be confirmed. Free space or allow site storage, then retry.
training.dryIntro: Dry practice means practicing without firing ammunition. Follow the firearm’s manual and your club’s instructions. Ask an instructor if unsure.
training.finish: End the practice clearly and put the firearm away using your storage routine. Do not handle live ammunition in the practice area.
training.intro: Download practice targets, read about safe dry practice and find federation rules.
training.observe: Use a simple aiming point for calm practice. Observe sight alignment and steadiness. Keep your finger off the trigger until deliberately dry firing in a safe direction.
training.pdfScale: A4 · Print at actual size (100%) · Scale check 50 mm
training.pdfSubtitle: Practice sheet, not an official competition target
training.prepare: Check the firearm is unloaded, including the magazine and chamber, following its manual. Check again after any interruption. Dry fire only if the manufacturer permits it, using any required equipment.
training.record: Record your goal, time and observations under a custom discipline. Mark dry practice in its name and notes so it is not confused with live fire.
training.safe: Choose an undisturbed space and a safe direction with a suitable backstop. Move all live ammunition elsewhere. Keep other people and animals out of the practice area.
training.targetHelp: Print on A4 at actual size (100%). Check the scale line. These are original practice sheets, not official competition targets. For live fire, use only an approved range with a suitable backstop.
training.title: Training materials
updates.available: A newer MyShotLog version is available.
updates.behind: This deployment is missing {count} upstream commits.
updates.configuration: Configure the code repository and deployed commit to enable update checks. See the installation guide.
updates.current: This deployment includes the latest upstream changes.
updates.forkHelp: Manual fork updates require a GitHub fork of aawse/myshotlog.
updates.heading: App updates
updates.help: Update checks are read-only. Open your code fork on GitHub and choose Sync fork → Update branch to apply updates, then wait for Vercel to deploy.
updates.pending: The fork is synced. Waiting for the updated deployment.
updates.permissions: GitHub could not read the public code repository. Check its visibility and availability.
updates.rateLimited: The update request limit was reached. Wait and try again later.
updates.ready: The updated deployment is ready. Reload to use it.
updates.unavailable: Updates could not be checked. Try again later.

validation.birthMinimum: Date of birth must be in 1900 or later
validation.birthMismatch: Date of birth and birth year do not match
validation.conditions: Series conditions are set on the session
validation.dryCustom: Choose a custom discipline for dry practice.
validation.dryShots: Dry practice must have zero live shots.
validation.elapsed: Enter a measured time above zero for completed dynamic results.
validation.figures: Figures require at least as many hits
validation.hits: Hits exceed the number of shots
validation.threshold: The threshold exceeds the test's maximum result
validation.yearFuture: Birth year cannot be in the future
validation.zeroShots: Enter at least one shot, or choose did not start, did not finish or disqualified.
witness.current: The sign-off covers the current results.
witness.drawRequired: Enter your name, draw a signature and confirm the results first.
witness.empty: No witness sign-offs have been saved yet.
witness.error: The witness sign-off could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.
witness.expires: The link expires at {time} and can be used for one sign-off.
witness.heading: Witness sign-offs
witness.help: A witness can sign off on one series or the whole session without an account. Sign-offs do not change medal assessments.
witness.identity: The witness provides their name; identity is not verified. The name and signature are saved in the owner’s private journal and Git history.
witness.inviteHelp: Review the results before entering your name and drawing your signature. No login is required.
witness.linkHelp: Share or copy the link now. It will not be shown again after reloading this page.
witness.memoryHelp: After a successful sign-off, this browser can fill in your name and signature next time. Review and confirm each sign-off. Turn this off on a shared device, or forget the saved witness before handing it over.
witness.memoryUnavailable: This browser could not update the saved witness. You can still sign off; browser storage settings control whether details can be remembered.
witness.name: Witness name
witness.noLink: Open the witness link or scan the QR code shown by the owner.
witness.qr: QR code for the witness link
witness.remember: Remember my name and signature on this device
witness.saved: Your witness sign-off has been saved. You can close this page.
witness.statement: I witnessed the shooting and confirm that the results shown here are correct.
witness.unavailable: This witness link has expired, been cancelled or used, or the results have changed. Ask the owner for a new link.
witness.viewSnapshot: Show the results that were signed
